description: 读者@相见恨吃 跟我说，听闻一些厂商陆续要开始给割草机器人装机械臂了。前有扫地机，后有割草机，这机械臂是非装不可吗？
classificationReason: The episode directly examines adding robotic arms to lawn-mowing robots and the associated market competition.
qualityReason: Provides a focused analysis of a concrete product trend, including named products, market figures, technical constraints, safety, cost, maintenance, competition, and commercialization tradeoffs.
